// diagnostic L0207

Jet.SharedBusyWait

This unbounded loop polls `Shared` state without waiting

What

This unbounded loop polls `Shared` state without waiting

Why

An empty or non-blocking body reads a lock-backed value repeatedly and can consume a core while another task makes progress

Fix

Wait on a `Condition` through an edit guard, or receive from a channel; an empty plain-field predicate can use that wait directly

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.SharedBusyWait: Tests/UILint/busy_spin.warn.
